Priya (Design): Quick sync 19 — tiny iteration on Autoscale row. Goals: 1) make SLO slider states explicit (Off / Preset / Custom), 2) move 'Burst capacity' to a compact right-aligned toggle so it doesn't vanish in dense rows, 3) ensure Tab order is pool picker -> burst -> slo. FigJam link in thread.
Noah (Frontend): Sounds good. Two constraints: (1) moving Burst out increases row height slightly, (2) keyboard order follows DOM. I can reorder DOM and implement a compact burst button; will prototype.
Ava (A11Y): Accessibility checks: burst pill contrast must be >=4.5:1 (light & dark). Slider needs aria-valuetext like "SLO target 200ms, preset" and preset chips should use aria-pressed. Ensure visible focus rings and no color-only states.
Sam (PM): Product constraints: default SLO should be conservative to avoid cost spikes. Add a guardrail when burst >50%: inline note "Higher burst may increase monthly cost 10 view estimate". No auto-upgrade, just soft nudge.
Jae (Eng): Backend notes: burst maps to burst_quota (scoped to pool_id). We'll cap burst_quota <= pool.max_gpus server-side and return a warning flag for the UI. Recommend feature-flagging under "autoscale-ui-v1".
Priya (Design): Thanks! I'll update FigJam with compact burst button, explicit slider states, and a11y checklist. Ping when the prototype is on staging and I'll run a quick keyboard pass. :rocket:
